function: Learned base-station linear precoder: a GNN maps the channel matrix to the precoding matrix, maximizing sum rate under non-linear PA distortion, trained self-supervised (pp. 3, 9).
system: Downlink massive MIMO, 64-antenna BS, K=1, 2 or 4 single-antenna users, 11th-order polynomial PAs, no RIS; narrowband, 5 GHz assumed only in power analysis (pp. 4, 18, 23).
method: Graph neural network (8 layers, 128 features, edge message passing) trained self-supervised by maximizing the sum rate with Adam; variant with SNR input (pp. 9, 12-14, 17).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh channels, [H]ij ~ CN(0,1), 500,000 for training and 10,000 for testing; pure-LOS ULA channels only for radiation patterns; no 3GPP or measured channels (p. 17).
test_conditions: Train/test at IBO -3 dB, 11th-order PA, Rayleigh, SNR -30 to 30 dB; retrained per IBO; also tested on Rapp PA unseen in training (pp. 14, 17, 21, 24).
baselines: Non-learned: MRT, ZF, ZF plus perfect DPD, Z3RO (single user), DAB (iterative gradient ascent). Learned: MLP and the authors' earlier CCNN, third-order PA only (pp. 9-11, 20).
metrics: Achievable sum rate (bits/channel use) from Bussgang SNIDR; radiation and SDR patterns; PA, DSP and total power consumption; FLOPs (pp. 7-8, 20-24).
complexity: FLOPs: GNN O(MKd^2L+M^2KdL+MK^2dL), about 51e6 in Table I example; DAB 14e12; ZF O(K^3+K^2M); text gives 164 MFLOPs for M=64, K=4 (pp. 15-17, 23).
q1_support: p. 17: "sampled from a complex normal distribution with zero mean and variance one". Not met: custom Rayleigh channels, plus a pure-LOS ULA channel for radiation patterns (p. 7, Eq. 12); no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured channel.
q2_support: p. 24: "the GNN precoder which is trained on the eleventh order PA model is evaluated on the modified Rapp model". The new condition is the PA characteristic, with the same Rayleigh channels (p. 25, Fig. 12).
q3_support: p. 11: "the GNN achieves the highest sum rate as compared to the CCNN and MLP" (learned baselines, CCNN from the authors' earlier work [26]); p. 20: "The GNN precoder shows superior performance over the DAB precoder" (non-learned; also ZF and MRT).
q4_support: p. 23: "164 MFLOPs are required to compute one forward pass of the GNN"; Table I (p. 17) gives the FLOPs order of the GNN, ZF and DAB.
q5_support: p. 17: "The training set consists of 500 000 generated channels". Not met: the channels are generated by the authors, and no link to code or data and no public dataset is given.
notes: Included as area 3: the learned function is the BS precoder W = f(H), not a PA linearizer; the paper says the GNN could be combined with DPD (p. 21). Reviewer checks: (1) q2 rests only on the Rapp PA test (p. 24), a different PA characteristic from the polynomial used for training; SNR, IBO and user-number changes were handled by sweeping or retraining (pp. 14, 21). (2) q3: the learned baselines (MLP, CCNN) are compared only under the third-order PA (Fig. 3a, p. 11); the 11th-order results compare with ZF, ZF plus DPD and DAB. (3) The FLOPs example of Table I (51e6) differs from the 164 MFLOPs of p. 23. (4) q1 is 0: the only 3GPP item is a PA model contribution [29] (p. 6, footnote 1), not a channel model.
